id: title:Gilbert09:skip the sms templates table when sms isn t enabled

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector reliability: P1.F1.H1 adds a gated feature parameter to prevent warehouse import failures when SMS templates are unavailable; P1.F2.H1 adds regression tests for this behavior.
review.reason: The chunk implements a bounded reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion. P1.F1.H1 adds a configuration parameter to skip fetching SMS templates when the feature is disabled, preventing connector failures. P1.F2.H1 adds a test case to verify the connector handles 404 responses without failure. This demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test protection of the new behavior. The score does not account for unverified outcomes such as actual incident avoidance or adoption, nor does it account for the potential broader impact of this change on warehouse ingestion stability.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the gated_feature parameter or the corresponding test execution, so the tier cannot be assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds gated_feature='SMS' to ClerkEndpointConfig for sms_templates, with a comment explaining Clerk returns 404 when SMS is disabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion connector to skip SMS template fetching when the feature is disabled, rather than failing the entire import.

observations.behavior: Adds a test case asserting that SMS templates 404 responses are handled without failure.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new gated behavior.
